entry.title: AI World Gen: thousands of decisions, and a loop that graded them
entry.summary: A map generator that asks a decision model one question per tile, about 3,000 times per test run for 25 cents, and the evaluation loop in Galtea that took it from a green blur to a village, one measured change at a time.

entry.title: Why a blog, now
entry.summary: For years, writing for the web meant writing for a ranking. Now language models read everything that is public, so a plain page about a small problem can become the answer someone gets. That is why this blog exists, and why its posts are plain HTML.
